description: Gateway throughput (wave 3c): fake world (tools/olife/world_fake.py, no engine) + gateway (vc = gateway_dev.py, --impl rs = Rust olife-gateway) + protocol bots (tools/olife/gw_load.py) flooding WITHIN the limits: 55 PlayerInput/s per session (limit 60), every 20th message a 200-byte ChatSend fanned out by the world as Multicast to all sessions. Nothing may be dropped: every bot ends with Bye, no rejects, >= 95% of the plan sent. Measures msgs/s up/down, TickSync delay world->bot through the gateway, gateway CPU and memory (psutil).
